dog.description_text: My foster writes: Despite my tigerish good looks I am a playful softie with a soul patch on my chin. I rely on my sibling Charlie to show me the ropes in new situations but once I come out of my shell, I'll let you know we are in the tribe together with lots of head bunts and rubs, and invite lots of pets, head/chin skritches and even belly rubs! I'm known to clown around to encourage my cat friends to play. I can be shy and hide at first, but we can quickly form a bond by sitting on the floor together with treats and you chatting with me softly. I'm target trained and proud of my good litter box habits. I looove the cat dancer - and wand toys bring out my inner athlete!
dog.name: Stevie
